meta.validity_rule: a null counts as evidence only if p01 <= observed lambda_1 <= p99, p01 and p99 from one np.percentile call on the null lambda_1 (the call that gives the rank p99s); percentiles reported as 100 (#{null < obs} + #{null == obs}/2) / n
meta.note_3pl: 3pl_post uses c = 0.25 for every score; for the >=k scores this floor is nominal (a uniform guesser is correct in >= k of 4 rotations with another probability)
meta.note_letter_post: letter_post (rotation-0 know-or-guess) exists only for rotation 0; the 4-rotation know-or-guess nulls kg_letter4 / kg_uniform4 apply to every score
